Using a magitrix, mages can create a multiblock magic station called a 'magitrix'. This structure uses scrolls of binding to capture and transfer casted spells into it, creating spell scrolls.

Once the 'magitrix' is created a 'duplication magic array' will appear. Select a spell to copy in your staff, hold a scroll of binding in the offhand, stand on the 'duplication magic array', then cast the spell. It will take a while to complete the spell scroll.

Only spells from grimoires can be duplicatied. Non-mages can also use spell scrolls.

Mana is a valuable resource for a mage. This block allows mages to store mana for later use. Start with making a mana lacrima. Think of this as a portable mana battery and is required to use the mana vault. Each mana lacrima has a max amount of mana it can hold and can easily be swapped around.

Using the mana vault is simple. To take mana, Right mouse click the top orb section of the mana vault. To store your mana, Shift + Right mouse click the same top orb section. If you hold down the mouse click, it will continuously store or retrieve mana as long as you keep looking at the top orb section.

Keep in mind, you cannot get mana from an empty mana lacrima. You also cannot hold more mana than your total max mana. Storing or retrieving mana will put stress on a mage applying a fatigue and weakness debuff.

Not all spells are accessible for every mage. Spells outside of the 'General' spell school requires a mage to specialize in that spell school to be able to understand and cast those kind of spells.

Start by throwing [Q] a rift charge into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. When you have the resulting essence core, Right mouse click it to mark the spell school on the core. Various cores will have different spell schools they can become. When a spell school is selected, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to start the conversion to an attunement core. After that, [Sneak] + Right mouse click again to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing an attunement core there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

Using an oculus core and oculus pedestal, mages can create a multiblock magic station called an 'oculus'. This structure can perform a magical feat called 'synthesis' which allows the creation of new grimoires.

Once the 'oculus' is created, throw ('Q' key) in a spell cipher into the portal. Use the pedestal to see what item is needed next. Once all of the ingredients are in, the portal will chance colors. Link the required essence generator to the oculus core and cast 'Transmutation' on the pedestal. The essence is consumed and a grimoire will be created.

Beware, this is a very delicate process. Throwing reagents in that are not required will end in catastrophy.

When flowers or rift anchors (riftbloom) are in range of a rift, they have a chance to transform temporarily into an 'unstable rust plant'. When harvested with a knife, this plant has a chance of dropping seeds used to grow stable versions of the plant. If the rift disappears, unstable riftblooms will slowly convert back into their original object.

This anchor will produce different sized crystals depending on how deep they are placed.

Be careful if trying to harvest unstable crystals. There can be consequences for messing with the void...

When rift anchors (rust crystal) are in range of a rift, they have a chance to transform temporarily into an 'unstable rust crystal'. Depth underground will dictate the crystal size. If the rift disappears, these crystals will slowly convert back into their original object.

Rifts are more than just links to the rust, if used right they can be wells of vast power. Casting the spell 'Serenity I' will close the rifts and the condensed primordial energy gathered will drop this item. This is a vital component for a powerful mage.

Grimoires alone cannot cast a spell. They are just a special book containing the knowledge of a spell. You will need something more.

You must Right mouse click on this block and 'soulbind' with it to form a connection with you. Once this is done, any grimoire you place on the shelves will become available through any staff you hold. This is the way a mage can acquire and use spells.

Just because you place a grimoire in a slot doesn't mean you can use it. You will need the mana to cast the spells and you must attune to specific spell schools to use most spells with the 'General' spell school being the exception. The other spell schools are Evocation, Alteration, Incantation, and Conjuration.
